['Th\u00fcga AG '].company_description: Thüga AG is a German energy company that operates in the regional energy supply sector. It provides electricity, gas, heat, and water to approximately one million people in Hessen and neighboring provinces.

['Metro AG '].company_description: Metro AG is a German multinational company that operates business membership-only cash and carry stores primarily under the Metro brand. It operates around 661 stores in 31 countries in Europe and Asia. Metro AG was established in 1964 and was the fourth-largest retailer in the world by revenues in 2010. It was spun off from the old Metro AG in 2017 and continues to be a prominent player in the retail industry.
